title: The 7-Eleven 5-Question Barrage
titleJa: コンビニレジ連环5问：3秒忍者通关
scenarioSetup: You placed a cold drink and a katsu-curry bento on the checkout counter. The cashier speaks at 1.5x speed. Face the 5 questions in sequence!

rounds.clerkPrompt: ポイントカードはお持ちですか？
rounds.clerkRomaji: Pointo kādo wa o-mochi desu ka?
rounds.clerkEnglish: Do you have a store point card?

options.text: ないです（大丈夫です）
options.nuance: Perfect 1-second response. Short and natural.

options.text: 私のポイントカードはどこにあるかわかりません
options.nuance: Too long! Blocks the line.

options.text: ポイントをたくさんください
options.nuance: Nonsensical: 'Give me lots of points'.

rounds.clerkEnglish: Shall I warm up your bento in the microwave?

options.text: はい、温めてください（お願いします）
options.nuance: Standard polite request to microwave.

options.text: 熱く燃やしてください
options.nuance: 'Please burn it with fire' — dangerously wrong!

options.text: 家で食べます
options.nuance: Doesn't answer whether you want it microwaved now.

rounds.clerkPrompt: お箸かスプーンはお付けしますか？
rounds.clerkRomaji: O-hashi ka supūn wa o-tsuke shimasu ka?
rounds.clerkEnglish: Would you like chopsticks or a spoon?

options.text: スプーンを一本お願いします
options.nuance: Clear specification for curry/soup dishes.

options.text: 手で食べますから不要です
options.nuance: 'I'll eat with bare hands' — unnecessary overshare.

options.text: フォークを10本ください
options.nuance: Asking for 10 forks for 1 bento is hoarding.

rounds.clerkPrompt: 温かいものと冷たいもの、袋はお分けしますか？
rounds.clerkRomaji: Atatakai mono to tsumetai mono, fukuro wa o-wake shimasu ka?
rounds.clerkEnglish: Shall I put cold drink and hot bento in separate bags?

options.text: 一緒でいいです（袋は大丈夫です）
options.nuance: Tokyo native shortcut: 'Together is fine' saves plastic and money.

options.text: 地球温暖化を防ぐために袋を断ります
options.nuance: Preachy environmental speech at 8:30 AM rush hour.

options.text: 全部ポケットに入れます
options.nuance: 'I'll put hot curry in my pocket' — good luck!

rounds.clerkPrompt: お支払い方法はどうされますか？
rounds.clerkRomaji: O-shiharai hōhō wa dō saremasu ka?

options.text: Suicaで！（タッチ決済で / PayPayで）
options.nuance: Fastest contactless payment. Tap and done in 0.5s.

options.text: 1万円札で1円単位まで小銭を崩したいです
options.nuance: Paying 10,000 yen for 150 yen item with exact pennies causes dread.

options.text: お金は払いたくありません
options.nuance: That's shoplifting!

ninjaComboPhrase: 「ないです・温めで・スプーン1本・一緒で・Suicaで！」
ninjaComboExplanation: Master this 5-word combo and cashiers will mistake you for a 10-year Tokyo resident.

title: Ramen Counter: The 3-Step Customization Cipher
titleJa: 家系・博多ラーメン：お好み呪文と替え玉暗号
scenarioSetup: You hand your ticket over the greasy ramen counter. The chef shouts: 『ヘイ！お好みは！？』 (What's your preference?!). Respond like a veteran ramen maniac.

rounds.clerkPrompt: 麺の硬さはどうしますか？
rounds.clerkRomaji: Men no katasa wa dō shimasu ka?

options.text: 硬めで！（博多なら：バリカタで！）
options.nuance: 'Katame' (Firm) or 'Barikata' (Super Firm) gives the best texture.

options.text: ドロドロに溶けるまで茹でてください
options.nuance: 'Boil until it dissolves into mush' — the chef will cry.

options.text: 生麺のまま食べます
options.nuance: Raw flour is not recommended.

rounds.clerkRomaji: Aji no kosa to abura no ryō wa?
rounds.clerkEnglish: Flavor concentration and chicken oil amount?

options.text: 味普通、油少なめで！
options.nuance: The golden balanced ratio for Iekei ramen.

options.text: 油を1リットル飲ませてください
options.nuance: Instant heart attack.

options.text: 塩分ゼロでお願いします
options.nuance: Go to an organic vegan salad bar instead.

rounds.clerkPrompt: スープが余って麺がなくなった！どうする？
rounds.clerkRomaji: Sūpu ga amatte men ga nakunatta! Dō suru?
rounds.clerkEnglish: Finished your noodles but still have hot soup left. What do you say?

options.text: すみません、替え玉（かえだま）をバリカタで！
options.nuance: Official way to order extra noodle refill into existing soup.

options.text: 新しくラーメンをもう一杯最初から作って
options.nuance: You will pay another 1,000 yen for a whole new bowl.

options.text: スープをお持ち帰り用の水筒に入れます
options.nuance: Pouring hot ramen broth into your water bottle is frowned upon.

ninjaComboPhrase: 「硬め・普通・少なめ！あと替え玉バリカタで！」
ninjaComboExplanation: Say this smoothly without looking at the wall menu and the chef will give you nod of supreme respect.

title: Izakaya Night: The Mystery Otōshi & The 'X' Check Sign
titleJa: 居酒屋の洗礼：お通し（謎の小鉢）と「X」会計サイン
scenarioSetup: You sit down on beer crate stools under the train tracks. The staff rushes over with high energy before you even open the menu.

rounds.clerkPrompt: いらっしゃい！お飲み物は何にしますか！？
rounds.clerkRomaji: Irasshai! O-nomimono wa nan ni shimasu ka!?
rounds.clerkEnglish: Welcome! What drinks can I get started for everyone!?

options.text: とりあえず生（中ジョッキ）で！
options.nuance: The undisputed Japanese opening chant: Draft beer for now!

options.text: 温かい白湯（さゆ）を一杯
options.nuance: Ordering hot plain boiled water at an Izakaya baffles the staff.

options.text: 10分間考えさせてください
options.nuance: Leaving the staff standing during opening drink round freezes the vibe.

rounds.clerkPrompt: 頼んでいない小鉢（枝豆など）が置かれた！これ何？
rounds.clerkRomaji: Tanonde inai kobachi ga okareta! Kore nani?
rounds.clerkEnglish: A small dish of edamame/stew arrived that you didn't order. What is it?

options.text: 『お通し（お通し代）』として席料込みで楽しむ
options.nuance: Otōshi is the traditional Japanese table cover charge appetizer (300-500 yen).

options.text: 警察を呼んで詐欺だと叫ぶ
options.nuance: It's standard Japanese cultural custom, not fraud.

options.text: 隣の客のテーブルに勝手に押し戻す
options.nuance: Causes an immediate brawl.

rounds.clerkPrompt: 店内がガヤガヤしてて声が通らない！お会計を頼む合図は？
rounds.clerkRomaji: Tennai ga gayagaya shitete koe ga tōranai! O-kaikei o tanomu aizu wa?
rounds.clerkEnglish: The izakaya is noisy. How do you signal for the bill from across the room?

options.text: 両手の人差し指で『X（バツ）』を作って店員を見る
options.nuance: Universal Japanese non-verbal body language for 'Check please / We are done'.

options.text: テーブルをひっくり返す
options.nuance: Table-flipping is only for retro angry anime dads.

options.text: 大声で歌を歌い始める
options.nuance: Staff will think you are drunk, not paying.

ninjaComboPhrase: 「とりあえず生！」＆「指でXサイン（お会計）」
ninjaComboExplanation: Master the opening chant and the closing X gesture, and izakaya dining becomes an effortless joy.
